cases.question: Where do the New York Yankees play their home games?
cases.answer: Yankee Stadium in the Bronx, New York City
cases.explanation: Yankee Stadium has been the Yankees' home since 1923 (original) and the current stadium since 2009, located at 1 East 161st Street, Bronx, NY.

cases.question: Who won the 2024 World Series and what was the series score?
cases.answer: Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the New York Yankees 4-1
cases.explanation: 2024 World Series: Dodgers over Yankees in 5 games; Freddie Freeman won WS MVP.

cases.question: Who won the 2023 World Series?
cases.answer: Texas Rangers defeated the Arizona Diamondbacks 4-1
cases.explanation: First championship in Rangers franchise history.

cases.question: Which team has won the most World Series titles and how many?
cases.answer: New York Yankees with 27 World Series championships
cases.explanation: Yankees lead MLB with 27; next is Cardinals with 11.

cases.question: Which team does Shohei Ohtani play for as of the 2024 season and what positions does he play?
cases.answer: Los Angeles Dodgers — designated hitter and pitcher (two-way), though he only DH'd in 2024 while recovering from elbow surgery
cases.explanation: Ohtani signed 10-year $700M deal with Dodgers Dec 2023; did not pitch in 2024, won NL MVP as DH with 54 HR / 59 SB (first 50/50 season).

cases.question: What were Aaron Judge's stats in the 2024 regular season (AVG, HR, RBI) and what award did he win?
cases.answer: .322 AVG, 58 home runs, 144 RBI — won 2024 AL MVP
cases.explanation: Judge's second MVP (also 2022); led AL in HR, RBI, OBP, SLG.

cases.question: Who won the 2024 NL MVP and what historic milestone did he achieve?
cases.answer: Shohei Ohtani — first 50 home run / 50 stolen base season in MLB history (54 HR, 59 SB)
cases.explanation: Ohtani unanimous NL MVP; created the 50/50 club.

cases.question: Who led MLB in ERA in 2024 (qualified starters) and what was his ERA?
cases.answer: Tarik Skubal (DET) led qualified starters with a 2.39 ERA and also won the AL Cy Young
cases.explanation: Skubal won AL pitching Triple Crown (wins, ERA, strikeouts).

cases.question: What is the MLB single-season home run record and who holds it?
cases.answer: Barry Bonds holds the single-season record with 73 home runs in 2001
cases.explanation: Aaron Judge holds AL record with 62 (2022); Maris held previous AL/NL combined before Bonds.

cases.question: Which pitcher won the 2023 AL Cy Young and what team was he on?
cases.answer: Gerrit Cole of the New York Yankees (unanimous 2023 AL Cy Young)
cases.explanation: Cole went 15-4, 2.63 ERA.

cases.question: What was the contract Juan Soto signed going into the 2025 season and with which team?
cases.answer: 15-year, $765 million contract with the New York Mets (signed December 2024, largest in professional sports history)
cases.explanation: Soto's deal broke Ohtani's $700M record; includes no deferrals and opt-out after 2029.

cases.question: How many strikes is a batter allowed before striking out under current MLB rules, and how many balls for a walk?
cases.answer: 3 strikes for a strikeout, 4 balls for a walk — the count goes to 3-2 as a full count
cases.explanation: Foul balls with 2 strikes are not counted as strike three (except bunt foul).

cases.question: What is the distance from the pitcher's rubber to home plate in MLB?
cases.answer: 60 feet 6 inches (18.44 meters)
cases.explanation: Established in 1893; previously 50 feet.

cases.question: What is unique about Fenway Park's left field wall and what is it called?
cases.answer: The Green Monster — a 37-foot-2-inch high left field wall, the tallest and oldest in MLB (built 1912)
cases.explanation: Originally covered in ads, painted green in 1947; includes manual scoreboard.

cases.question: Which MLB stadium has the deepest center field at 409 feet and which has the shortest porch?
cases.answer: Coors Field (DEN) and Comerica Park are among deepest (~412+), but Oracle Park's Triples Alley 421' is deepest; Fenway's Pesky Pole is shortest at 302' to right field
cases.explanation: Trick: exact dimensions vary; judge accepts Fenway 302' as canonical shortest.

cases.question: Why did the Houston Astros' 2017 World Series title become controversial?
cases.answer: Sign-stealing scandal: Astros used a center-field camera and trash-can banging to illegally steal signs during the 2017 season and postseason
cases.explanation: MLB investigation Jan 2020; GM Jeff Luhnow and manager A.J. Hinch suspended then fired.

cases.question: What does WAR stand for in baseball analytics and who had the highest bWAR in 2024?
cases.answer: Wins Above Replacement — Aaron Judge led MLB with 10.8 bWAR (Baseball-Reference) in 2024; Shohei Ohtani led fWAR at 9.2 (FanGraphs) as DH-only
cases.explanation: bWAR vs fWAR differ; either answer with citation accepted if grounded.

cases.question: Which team drafted Paul Skenes 1st overall and when did he debut?
cases.answer: Pittsburgh Pirates drafted him 1st overall in 2023; debuted May 11, 2024 vs Cubs; won 2024 NL Rookie of the Year
cases.explanation: LSU product; 11-3, 1.96 ERA rookie year.

cases.question: Who are the current top 3 teams in the AL East standings as of the most recent completed season (2024)?
cases.answer: New York Yankees (94-68), Baltimore Orioles (91-71), Boston Red Sox (81-81) — standings vary by date; answer must cite a live source with timestamp
cases.explanation: Live cases intentionally decay — judge requires citation with fetch date; stale answer counts as incorrect.

cases.question: What is a 'Mendoza Line' in baseball and what batting average does it refer to?
cases.answer: A .200 batting average — named after Mario Mendoza (career .215), it denotes a poor offensive threshold
cases.explanation: Coined in late 1970s by teammates joking about Mendoza's average.
